name: 音声入力付き検索欄
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate ONE corrected Lighthouse catalog component LH01-0001 音声入力付き検索欄.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: input1 ORIGINAL Google Maps screenshot is authoritative for icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Inspect its top search capsule ONLY, source pixels x36 y197 width1109 height154. Input2 is our rough Japanese mock: secondary authority ONLY for localized wording and overall isolated layout. Its hollow microphone substitute is inaccurate; DO NOT copy that icon. Input3 is approved bus design: surface/style only, never its content.
Render one horizontal white search capsule with a left back chevron, Japanese placeholder "地域や施設を検索", and right microphone. The original microphone has a SOLID filled rounded vertical capsule as the microphone head, a separate U-shaped support below/around it, and a short central vertical stem continuing downward. Preserve that compact original glyph: no hollow center and no wide horizontal pedestal. Render its solid head and support in coherent slate #526173. Match original back chevron optical proportions and original icon/control alignment. Keep original controls and visible empty/unfocused state. Omit all original recent results, contact CTA, keyboard, app label, status bar and device chrome because those are outside this single component.
Official Lighthouse styling: pure white #FFFFFF canvas/control; fine neutral outline, gentle rounded pill, faint downward shadow, no mint background/glow. Slate utility icons, neutral gray placeholder. No extra accent: scoped original has no selection/status and these icons are utility controls, not filled primary actions. Do not add green decoration or a new action.
Typography locked: Meiryo Regular14px/24px at logical390px width, tracking0, a single line. Use delicate regular strokes rather than bold/semibold. Wide3:1 white canvas, component near94% width, compact control height, modest margins, flat frontal UI screenshot. Preserve wording exactly; no additional text, buttons, icons or features.
reviewNotes: 最新所有者指示を適用し原参照をアイコン・光学的太さ・細部の優先資料として実入力。モックの中空マイクを採用せず原画面の塗りつぶしカプセル＋U字支持＋短い柄へ修正。日本語、空欄、戻る、音声入力を保持し白面と欠けなしを視認。機能的アクセントなしの原欄なのでスレート補助アイコン、追加色なし。v1/v2は履歴保存、v2の旧レビューは最新図形基準の合格ではない。静止画像のエージェントレビューのみ。厳密フォント一致、所有者承認、編集可能性、実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
